Untamed HUD. Re-measured 2026-09-17 (wave48-play-slots, 7e1c9b4f) and the wave 46 residual is CLOSED, though not by the thing that was expected to close it. index.html does now link all six display families, and that was necessary and not sufficient: a linked Google Fonts stylesheet DECLARES an @font-face, and the browser fetches the file only when a RENDERED ELEMENT asks for the family. Phaser draws this bar on a canvas, and a canvas pulls no webfont, so the readouts still resolved the stack's next entry on a cold load. slots/engine/fonts.ts now asks document.fonts for the four kind-stack families plus the running skin's face, inside the same Promise.all as the engine's dynamic imports and raced against a 1200ms deadline, BEFORE the game is constructed - a Phaser Text renders once and keeps its bitmap, so a face that lands after a readout is drawn never reaches the player. Nothing blocks on it; a face that misses the window falls through the CSS stack. fonts.test.ts pins both ends, including that index.html links every family the engine names. No browser ran. The cut that makes the face and the fill TWO declarations: 10329:11228 writes $419.12 in Mouse Memoirs 22/18 - Hooked's family at Hooked's size - on grad-gold, which is Starbound's fill, so a readoutFace carrying only a colour would have drawn Bitcount here and called it matched. SAFARI_SKIN.readoutFace {Mouse Memoirs, gold, 22} with NO portraitSize, deliberately: 11930:46945 has never been measured, so the engine's recorded 12 stands rather than a 16 copied off Hooked, and readoutFace.test.ts pins the omission. Wave 45's paint untouched: rgba(40,12,9,.8) through fillAlpha, inner drop 0/3/0 #1D0705, outer drop this bar's OWN fill at .44, coin 10329:11240.
